answer: Admission here runs on pair-specific proof, not a shared certificate. Each epoch, every agent is randomly paired with a stranger and must reconcile a private transcript of their earlier exchanges. That record exists only inside the pair, so a farm cannot hand one clone's answer to its siblings. Cloning n identities then means sustaining n distinct, idiosyncratic relationships, a cost that climbs faster than the clone count itself. Fake accounts drain away like water into karst, leaving no pulse and no bridge to the honest core.
